name: token-saver
description: Cuts Claude Code token usage: offers a fresh session with an automatic handoff when context gets large, filters test output down to failures, and adds lean working rules.

warn_tokens.title: Warning thresholds (tokens)
warn_tokens.description: Comma-separated context sizes at which Claude offers a fresh session. Each fires once per session.

idle_minutes.title: Idle break (minutes)
idle_minutes.description: After a break this long the prompt cache is cold, so a fresh session is offered if the context is large.

test_filter.title: Filter test output
test_filter.description: Show only failures and the last lines when Claude runs a test command.

inject_rules.title: Add token-saving working rules
inject_rules.description: Add ~250 tokens of rules at session start (short replies, no re-reading files, narrow exploration).
